title: Palace: Criticism of billions reallocated to Sandro Marcos’ district ‘premature’
summary: Criticisms against the reallocation of billions of taxpayers’ money to the district of President Ferdinand Marcos’ lawmaker-son remain “premature,” Malacañang said on Thursday.
